meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在代码交付前跑一遍人工验收与质量审查,给出是否可提交的结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚完成一批工作,想在交付或发起 PR 前确认质量与风险都过关
copy.tagline_en: Run acceptance and quality review before shipping to confirm readiness
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've finished a batch of work and want quality and risk checked before handoff

howto.what: 在你完成实现后,Claude 会自己在真实界面上做手工 QA,再启动一个(而非一组)审查员,对照目标、约束、安全与 QA 证据审计整个改动,产出 QA 矩阵和通过/不通过结论。
howto.when: 在你把 PR 交接出去之前,或者你明确要求复查已完成的工作时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这次改动,告诉我通过还是不通过
say.note: 它先自己做手工 QA,再启动一个审查员

say.text: PR 交接前先跑一遍 review-work
say.note: 会在专用审查 worktree 里做检查

say.text: 对照原始目标和约束,复查这个分支
say.note: 读取原目标、约束和 QA 证据

howto.what_en: After you finish work, Claude runs manual QA itself on the real surface, then launches ONE gate reviewer (not a panel) to audit the change against goal, constraints, safety and QA evidence, and returns a QA matrix plus APPROVE/FAILED.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

say_en.text: Review this change and tell me if it passes or fails.
say_en.note: Runs manual QA first, then one gate reviewer.

say_en.text: Run review-work on this branch before I hand off the PR.
say_en.note: Checks the branch in a locked review worktree.

say_en.text: Re-review this branch against the original goal and constraints.
say_en.note: Uses the saved goal, constraints and QA evidence.
